data.description: Luxury Living with Nature-Inspired Surroundings | Parkside Boulevard, Arjan
data.long_description:
Live the resort lifestyle every day at Parkside Boulevard, a modern residential community in Arjan by Tabeer. With its sleek architectural design and lush landscaping, this development offers a peaceful escape just minutes from the city’s major attractions. Choose from 165 expertly designed residences, including studios and 1–2 bedroom apartments—some with private pools.

Each home is crafted with premium materials, open-plan layouts, and smart home systems for ultimate convenience. Enjoy expansive views and elegant interiors designed to accommodate both daily living and relaxation in style. It's the perfect setting for those seeking both comfort and innovation.

Parkside Boulevard features top-tier amenities: a large pool, fitness center, sauna, kids’ pool and playground, BBQ area, and an outdoor cinema. With retail spaces and ample parking, everything you need is right within your reach. This is more than a home—it’s a destination.
